points.label: Shared baptized identity
points.left: Paul appeals for Onesimus as brother, self, and received guest. Therefore though I have all boldness in Christ to command you that which is appropriate, Also, prepare a guest room for me, for I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you.
points.right: Faith, baptism, shared identity, and Abraham’s offspring. But before faith came, we were kept in custody under the law, confined for the faith which should afterwards be revealed. If you are Christ’s, then you are Abraham’s offspring and heirs according to promise.
